localPatches.description: Use the SVG rendering container width for C4 layout instead of the physical screen width, retaining the original fallback when no container width is measurable.
Allocate branch positions using measured wrapped-label heights and leave measured clearance between adjacent category groups. Preserve the original tree, arrow direction, cause order and text.

Measure connected styled name and note rows, then place them within their semantic regions using bounded interval search. Preserve source, note identities, set values and circle geometry; expose an actionable diagnostic when placement fails.
